'''Shadow Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Shadow Squadron (Itani Nebula)|Shadow Squadron]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] flew [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] as Shadow Leader of [[Shadow Squadron (Itani Nebula)|Shadow Squadron]] during a [[battle near the Itani Nebula]] and the following [[Assault on Kamino]].
